slug: 2025-09-23 Review of Mozambique's Proposed Personal Data Protection Law

facts.fact: TechHive Advisory reviewed a comprehensive draft Personal Data Protection Law for Mozambique; the review gives no date for the draft, so its published date is used.

The draft law designates the existing Regulatory Authority for ICT to take the role of National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (ANPD), alongside a National Council chaired by the Prime Minister; the review's published date is used as no other date is given.
